title: Negros Occidental gov calls for ‘compassionate’ pricing of sugar

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL — Negros Occidental Gov. Eugenio Jose Lacson said he hopes the buying price of sugar hits P3,000 per 50-kilogram bag (Lkg) to enable farmers to survive. “We cannot compel the traders to buy at the price we want [but] we are hoping they understand the situation and are more compassionate,” he said. This crop year, the country is estimated to produce 1.6 million metric tons of sugar, and he hopes the farmers can average P3,000 per LKg to make it sustainable, Lacson said.
